narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience on the origins of the political terms 'left-wing' and 'right-wing,' tracing them back to the French Revolution. It explores how these definitions have evolved into complex economic and social frameworks. By using the example of the Nazi Party's full name, it illustrates the contradictions within simple binary labels and encourages viewers to look beyond 'left vs. right' or 'blue vs. green' (Taiwanese politics) to facilitate better public discourse.
